member.description: one person's membership in a space

person.description: the person the membership is for

role.description: owner runs the space and holds owner permission on every app in it; member belongs and holds only what a grant gives them

grant.description: what one principal is permitted to do with one app

app.description: the app the grant is on

person.description: the person it is for — absent on a share link, which names a token instead

token.description: an unguessable secret standing in for a person: whoever opens the link acts as this grant

access.description: owner shares and deletes, editor writes, viewer reads
what an app allows everyone who has no grant on it

mode.description: public: anyone reads. open: anyone reads and writes. private: only those with a permission see it.

_privacy.description: Who may read this entity, as the personal, inherited and readers declarations say of its components and of what it inherits from; kept by @yaks/member's personal rule in the transaction that changes them, and screening a person's read where every entity's is current. An entity wearing none of those components keeps none.

person.description: The one person it is kept to; none where it is kept to no one in particular.

shut.description: True where it is kept to nobody: it names more than one person, or names nobody where a person was asked.

signed.description: True where a component asks its readers to be signed in.

floor.description: The highest level a component asks its readers to hold.

hash.description: The declarations it was reckoned under, as their hash: one other than the store's is stale.

_pace.description: The last accepted write of each paced component through each instrument on this entity; maintained by the write guard in the value's transaction.

writes.description: Independent component and via clocks, read whole; a null via pools writers carrying no instrument.
